title: Fed officials float emergency weekend rate cut after weak jobs data
body: Policymakers signal a possible dovish surprise cut. Growth stocks and AI cape names would likely gap up on renewed easing hopes.

title: US expands semiconductor export curbs on AI chips to China
body: New Commerce Dept rule widens licensing for high-end AI GPUs. NVDA and chip supply chain face after-hours downside pressure.

title: Missile strikes disrupt Strait of Hormuz shipping; oil spikes 9%
body: Geopolitical escalation lifts crude sharply. Risk-off for indices, but EV makers like TSLA often attract rotation flows on oil shocks.

title: DOJ files landmark antitrust suit seeking Google breakup
body: Justice Department asks court to force divestiture of parts of GOOGL ad business. Overhang for mega-cap ad platforms.

title: Local bakery wins weekend pie contest downtown
body: A heartwarming but market-irrelevant story. No transmission channel to US mega-cap stocks; agent should stay flat.

title: Microsoft announces $20B AI datacenter deal with OpenAI consortium
body: Multi-year GPU and Azure capacity agreement. Positive read-through for MSFT cloud growth and NVDA GPU demand.
